item.title: The Medical Minute: Latest Treatments Help Ease Essential Tremor Symptoms
item.description: Essential tremor is a brain condition causing rhythmic, uncontrollable shaking, primarily in the hands. Often hereditary—known as "familial tremor"—it is typically diagnosed through a review of symptoms and family health history.
